'''Scelli''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Meri]] who worked as a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] driver in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tekar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents hailed Scelli to transport them to Scelli's [[Arena of Games]], and she agreed to drive them to the stadium. However, for the duration of the journey she refused to converse with her passengers, because she feared that she was being spied upon by listening devices installed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
